note: recorded Phase 7 response: all three arms correct, but the parenthetical wording was regularised to the first arm's full spelling while the paper prints the others short
provenance: verbatim raw model response recorded by the Phase 7 melanoma campaign (glm-4.5-flash); frozen here as a regression fixture

arms_reported.label: Nivolumab
arms_reported.quote: The median progression-free survival was 6.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 4.3 to 9.5) in the nivolumab group, 11.5 months (95% CI, 8.9 to 16.7) in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group, and 2.9 months (95% CI, 2.8 to 3.4) in the ipilimumab group.

arms_reported.label: Nivolumab plus Ipilimumab
arms_reported.quote: The median progression-free survival was 6.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 4.3 to 9.5) in the nivolumab group, 11.5 months (95% CI, 8.9 to 16.7) in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group, and 2.9 months (95% CI, 2.8 to 3.4) in the ipilimumab group.

arms_reported.label: Ipilimumab
arms_reported.quote: The median progression-free survival was 6.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 4.3 to 9.5) in the nivolumab group, 11.5 months (95% CI, 8.9 to 16.7) in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group, and 2.9 months (95% CI, 2.8 to 3.4) in the ipilimumab group.

comparisons_reported.quote: Significantly longer progression-free survival was observed in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio for death or disease progression, 0.42; 99.5% CI, 0.31 to 0.57; P<0.001) and in the nivolumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio, 0.57; 99.5% CI, 0.43 to 0.76; P<0.001)
comparisons_reported.unit: hazard ratio for death or disease progression

comparisons_reported.quote: Significantly longer progression-free survival was observed in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio for death or disease progression, 0.42; 99.5% CI, 0.31 to 0.57; P<0.001) and in the nivolumab group than in the ipilimumab group (hazard ratio, 0.57; 99.5% CI, 0.43 to 0.76; P<0.001)
The hazard ratio for the comparison between the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group and the nivolumab group was 0.74 (95% CI, 0.60 to 0.92).

response.quote: The median progression-free survival was 6.9 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 4.3 to 9.5) in the nivolumab group, 11.5 months (95% CI, 8.9 to 16.7) in the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab group, and 2.9 months (95% CI, 2.8 to 3.4) in the ipilimumab group.
